goal: Travel from Pewter City through Mt Moon and reach Cerulean City

subgoals.goal_text: Move from the first floor of Mt Moon down to the basement (B1F).
Move from B1F down to the bottom floor (B2F).
Find and defeat the Super Nerd guarding the fossils on B2F.

macro_provenance.authored_by: none — escalation succeeded with no reproducible ops (see distill_refused_empty)

subgoals.goal_text: Navigate through Mt Moon B2F and exit the cave to the north.
Visit the Pokemon Center inside Mt Moon to restore the party's HP.
Leave the Mt Moon Pokemon Center and enter Route 4.
Travel east across Route 4 to arrive in Cerulean City.
